source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center outlook odds applied to the county's 1991-2020 precipitation record (NOAA NCEI nClimDiv). A tilt in the odds, not a promise; confidence fades with distance.
note: Inches are county-wide averages that include mountain ground, so valley and bench ranches usually receive less. Percent of normal carries over better than the inches.
